Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value From activities Join assays On activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id Join molecule_dictionary On activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno Join compound_structures On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno Join target_dictionary On assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid Filter activities.standard_relation = '=' And activities.pchembl_value Is Not Null And assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' And target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1075165' And activities.type = 'IC50' Select Distinct assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value From activities Join assays On activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id Join molecule_dictionary On activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno Join compound_structures On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno Join target_dictionary On assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid Filter activities.standard_relation = '=' And activities.pchembl_value Is Not Null And assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' And target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1075165' And activities.type = 'IC50' Order By molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id Limit 1000
